misread_policy.owner_principle: Binding OD-6 principle: a genuine misread of question data with unchanged object and difficulty costs one mark from A/B; all A/B follow through on the misread value and M/DM are judged as usual. Own-figure errors and misreads changing object/difficulty receive ordinary canonical marking. Practice feedback names the misread.
misread_policy.operational_status: proposed; reviewer-prescribed mechanics and planner settlement, pending Vitalis exact-manifest approval
misread_policy.operational_rules: Proposed MR03 operational rules, pending Vitalis approval of the exact manifest: decide and record eligibility once at first use; ineligible data remain canonical in every later part. For each eligible misread datum, first mark all gross evidence and dependencies, then deduct one mark from the first earned A/B on that datum in question/criterion order, moving to later-use parts if necessary. Deduct nothing only if no A/B is earned on the datum anywhere. Never deduct from M/DM or make the score negative. The selected criterion remains earned for every DM, dependency and www check; one datum costs at most one net mark. Eligible OD-6 follow-through overrides not-F.T. and c.a.o. restrictions, while correct working, named method exclusions and OD-1 still apply. No-solution exclusion means a misread removes a solution the canonical question has; a designed no-real-solution outcome remains eligible when its demand and difficulty are preserved. An A/B is on a datum when it lies in the datum's first-use part or a later part whose working uses the misread data, whether or not that criterion's own value changes. Eligibility is judged at first use for the connected question. Eligible follow-through never overrides MR09 (no F.T. into a supplied result) or OD-1 answer-only rules.
